title: React Query v5 ignores cacheTime configuration
reasoning: The project depends on @tanstack/react-query v5, where cacheTime was renamed to gcTime. PartDetails spreads a cacheTime property into useQuery and useQueries options, so the intended 10 minute garbage-collection window is ignored at runtime and the default v5 behavior is used instead.
recommendation: Rename cacheTime to gcTime in the shared queryConfig used by PartDetails, and verify TypeScript types catch stale option names for future query configuration changes.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests do not cover PartDetails caching behavior or query garbage-collection timing, and no typecheck command is configured in the project metadata.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a small unit/type-focused coverage path around the query configuration, or at minimum add typechecking to CI so invalid React Query option names are caught.
